correctness.rationale: The homogeneous Monge constraint is an order event on iid Laplace differences; independent exponential normalization gives the correct volume measure and mean total 2q. Conditional exponential splitting yields the exact centroid moment formula. Positive distributional curvature of the Laplace quantile gives strict discrete convexity, and harmonic sums and beta logarithmic moments rigorously prove endpoints and interior asymptotics. The q=2 independent Beta integral and 4036 exact-rational assertions for q<=36 check normalization/signs; finite checks are not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The exact centroid is a natural canonical geometric first moment of the Monge cost-matrix polytope, complementary to established face and volume formulas. Its strictly U-shaped column masses, exact rational coordinates in all dimensions 2q-1, and quantified logarithmic boundary layer reveal a non-obvious shape invariant relevant to uniform Monge-matrix sampling and integral geometry. This is neither an arbitrary finite census nor an immediate relabeling of the scalar volume result.
